review: Drafted by Claude for the purpose; no label has had human review yet. The same author wrote the labels and the candidate checks, so the held-out test split guards against tuning, not against the author's blind spots.
description: Labelled topics for AI-10's topic-coverage check (before generation). Each is a (course, topic) an exam could be requested for, over the retrieval evaluation corpus and its past-question distractors (data/retrieval_eval/v1). Original course-style text written for the purpose; no third-party material.
labelling_rule: covered: the lecture notes teach the topic, so at least one exam question with a supported answer can be set on it; evidence names the page and a verbatim span. Not covered: the notes don't teach it, even if they share its words or a past-question paper asks about it; why says what is missing. Categories: covered_direct (named as in the notes), covered_paraphrase (named in other words), covered_broad (a whole document or course area), near_miss (same course and subject, not taught), out_of_corpus (a subject the corpus doesn't teach).
splits: dev chooses thresholds; test is held out and only reported.
